limitations.text: This view reports whether an eligible provider is located in the same UAT. It does not estimate travel distance, travel time or cross-border access.
Providers without UAT-level location evidence are excluded from local counts and kept as named exclusions.
Bucharest sector rows are not included because the health mart can only place Bucharest providers at municipality level.
Provider-level bed counts exist only for health mart rows matched confidently to the Ministry clinical-beds workbook.
